items.source: Whether the given method parameter is supported by this resolver.
items.translation: 给定方法参数是否由该解析器支持。

items.source: Resolves a method parameter into an argument value from a given message.
items.translation: 将方法参数解析为来自给定消息的参数值。

items.source: Strategy interface for resolving method parameters into argument values in the context of a given Message.
items.translation: 用于在给定Message上下文中将方法参数解析为参数值的策略接口。

items.source: parameter - the method parameter to resolve. This parameter must have previously been passed to supportsParameter(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter) which must have returned true.
items.translation: parameter - 要解析的方法参数。此参数必须先前已传递给supportsParameter(org.springframework.core.MethodParameter)，且该方法必须返回 true。

items.source: true if this resolver supports the supplied parameter; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此解析器支持提供的参数；否则为 false。

items.source: Mono for the argument value, possibly empty
